root_cause: The daily optimizer measured broad queue/execution/fan-out only, sampled too narrowly, created its own pull_request fan-out, and could propose a new tuning PR every day solely because generated timestamps differed. It did not measure Required-specific latency, direct PR workflow count, duplicate authority or successor churn.
prevention: Measure bounded seven-day CI history with Required-specific p95, direct PR workflow inventory, duplicate run/obligation and retired-candidate churn. Remove optimizer/self-evolution direct PR ingress, enforce immutable SLO/safety budgets, ratchet direct-PR budget only downward, and emit no tuning PR when content is unchanged.
